validation.selection: SHA256(fresh-q3-v2:case_code), exclude all round1 evidence hashes
validation.use: validation only; no prior or threshold fitting

rollout.refinement: baseline and best alternative; guarantees a paired 12-world comparison
rollout.selection_guard: mean paired delta + one standard error < -3 seconds

attempt_clear.failures: retain exclusion disks, unchanged outer source geometry, normal baseline continuation

hard: no incomplete rollout scored as cheap
acceptance.tail_module: may remain conditional when useful on long-tail pressure cases with ordinary mean regression at most 1 percent

report: physical and strengthened guarantee lower bounds
tail costs are not confused with whole-task lower bound
